gloss: juggling several jobs or roles at once

definitions.gloss: holding several jobs, roles, or commitments at the same time
definitions.explanation: Taking on two or more jobs, roles, or activities concurrently and dividing one's time among them. Often used of part-time jobs, club activities, or appointments.

examples.japanese: ⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}け{持|も}ち⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: to work several part-time jobs at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クラブ→クラブ：10812_kurabu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}け{持|も}ち⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I belong to two clubs at the same time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}け{持|も}ち⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: She juggles work and housework, so she is busy every day.

notes:
Describes managing multiple commitments in parallel. Frequently used with ⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧ (part-time jobs) and ⟦クラブ→クラブ：10812_kurabu⟧ (clubs). As a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb it means to carry on several things at once.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掛|か}け{持|も}ち: working several part-time jobs
- {掛|か}け{持|も}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work multiple jobs
- ⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}け{持|も}ち⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to juggle overlapping schedules
